description: Central Provincial Council - Notify the Draft of the Amended Statute prepared for the Central Provincial Passenger Transport Service Authority
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a new provincial statute (Transport Services Authority Statute of Central Province No. 03 of 2018) that rescinds previous statutes and establishes a regulatory framework for transport services. It contains detailed legal provisions about the authority's establishment, composition, powers, and operational procedures. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves new regulations, statutory instruments, and legal frameworks for transport services management in the Central Province. While it mentions ministerial appointments and roles, these are part of the regulatory structure rather than the primary focus, which is the legal framework itself.
